farmerFriendlyExplanation: A combined, deadly attack by tiny sucking insects (thrips, mites, and whiteflies) acting in tandem with an invisible virus. These pests suck the vital sap and inject a poison that causes the leaves to curl, permanently stunting growth. Uproot and burn stunted plants, and spray alternating insecticides. Universally recognized as మూర్దా రోగ్ / పత్తీ మారోడ్ (Murda rog / Patti marod) in Hindi and ముర్దా కాంప్లెక్స్ / ఆకు ముడత (Murda complex / Aaku mudatha) in Telugu.
